s1.ptxt: Place gear shift lever in “1st” (M/T model) or selector lever in “P” range (A/T model), and block drive wheels.
Loosen parking brake adjusting nut (1) until parking brake cable becomes free of tension.
Start engine and depress brake pedal more than 3 times with about 150 N (15.3 kgf, 33.7 lbf).
Stop engine and check that lever of caliper (1) contacts the pin (2). If the caliper does not contact the pin, repeat Step 3) – 4) again.
Tighten parking brake adjusting nut (1) so that parking brake drags when parking brake is pulled by one notch.
Check that parking brake lever stroke is between 4 and 9 notches when the parking brake lever is pulled with 200 N (20.4 kgf, 45.0 lbf).
Check equalizer (2) inclination angle. If angle is not as specified, check parking brake cable, rear brake caliper and rear brake pads.
After completion of adjustment, release parking brake and check that parking brake is not dragging.
